title: Vertra template (dags/<name>.yaml, kind: Template), format v2
description: A runnable DAG with parameters: what a consumer runs, filling in only the parameters. Steps name actions, not images, so a template keeps working as products release new images, and each step uses its action's own secretRefs.

apiVersion.description: The catalog format: vertra.dev/v2. A file without it is from before v2: ./vertra catalog migrate rewrites it.

shareWith.description: The other teams that may run this template, or ["*"] for every team. Left out, only its own team.

visibility.description: listed (the default): every team sees this template in the console, and those it isn't shared with can ask for access. hidden: only its own team sees it, so it can't have shareWith.

deprecated.description: Marks it deprecated, saying what to use instead. It keeps working; the console shows the message to everyone who uses it.

parameters.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for an object: what the person running it fills in. It's also the form the console shows.

action.description: <product>.<action> of this team, or <team>/<product>.<action> of another team that shares it.

inputs.description: The action's inputs: a value, {$param: <name>} for a parameter, or {$fromStep: <id>, $output: <name>} for an output of a step in dependsOn.
